usedFor: Asana is where work gets discussed, and Vistaly collects feedback when a task comment runs “Create Feedback”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new comment is added to a task” in Asana, then “Create Feedback” in Vistaly
bestTemplate.why: Comments teammates leave on tasks become feedback entries in Vistaly without anyone copying them over.

watchOut: “When a new comment is added to a task” is polling, so feedback arrives after a scheduled check.
